description: Public Lever postings API (https://api.lever.co/v0/postings). Every Lever customer exposes an open job board at api.

novel_features.name: Generic company
novel_features.description: Single CLI serves any company that publishes through Lever (leverdemo, palantir, etc.) — company is a positional argument, not a hardcoded prefix.

novel_features.name: Company-scoped offline sync
novel_features.description: sync <company> fetches all open postings and persists them under a company-scoped store key (postings:<company>); --data-source local reads are isolated per company, so synced boards never mix.
